sources.title: GatekeeperZA/InternLM2-1.8B-w8a8-RKLLM-v1.2.3 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: RKLLM conversion of internlm/internlm2-chat-1_8b for Rockchip RK3588 NPU inference. Converted with RKLLM Toolkit v1.2.3. This model provides a different architecture option alongside Qwen3 models on the RK3588, offering strong multilingual support (English + Chinese) and good general-purpose chat capability at ~15.6 tokens/sec.

sources.title: GatekeeperZA/RKLLM-API-Server: RKLLM API Server - GitHub
sources.snippet: OpenAI-compatible API server for Rockchip NPU (RK3588/RK3576) running RKLLM models, designed as a drop-in backend for Open WebUI. Built for single-board computers like the Orange Pi 5 Plus, this server bridges the gap between the librkllmrt.so C runtime and any OpenAI-compatible frontend — enabling local, private LLM inference on ARM hardware with zero cloud dependency.
